blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) marked the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law with a call to defend democracy from “abuse of power, corruption, injustice, and the distortion of truth.” In a statement on Monday, Sept. 21, it said remembering is not merely looking back at the past. “It is a commitment not to allow the abuses we have experienced to happen again.” The CHR said it is one with the nation in remebering “one of the darkest periods in the history of the Philippines,” 54 years since martial law was declared in 1972 by […]...
